title: Two vessels hit by naval mines as US and Iran both claim Hormuz control
note: Al Jazeera reports two vessels were struck by naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz this week, while both the US and Iran claim control of the waterway. Mines add a lasting hazard to a chokepoint that carries much of the world's oil.

title: UN monitors report 85 percent rise in Ukrainian civilian casualties
note: The UN Secretary-General's briefing says the UN human rights mission counted an 85 percent rise in civilian casualties in September compared with a year earlier. Large-scale attacks killed at least six civilians and disrupted power and water in 11 regions, and a further wave on 17 October reportedly killed at least eight.
